tasks.label: build Java
args: $files = Get-ChildItem -Path src -Recurse -Filter *.java | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path build/classes -Force | Out-Null; javac -encoding UTF-8 -cp "lib/*" -d build/classes $files

tasks.label: clean Java build
args: if (Test-Path build/classes) { Remove-Item build/classes -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path build/classes -Force | Out-Null
